spans.s:
mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-र्षं)
Relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi.
m. (-र्षः)
A form of marriage, the father of the bride receiving one or two pair of kine from the bridegroom.
n. (-र्षं)
The Vedas.
f. (-र्षा)
One of the orders of the metres of the Vedas.
E.
ऋषि and अण् aff.

n. (-र्शः)
Hoemorrhoids, piles.
E.
ऋ to go, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and शुट् inserted.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Afflicted with hoemorrhoids.
E.
अर्शस् and अच् aff.

m. (-नः)
Fire.
E.
ऋ to go, शानच् affix, and शुट् inserted.

mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि)
Afflicted with hoemorrhoids.
E.
अश, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं)
Destroying the hoemorrhoids.
m. (-घ्नः)
An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.)
f. (-घ्नी)
A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.)
E.
अर्शस्, and घ्न what destroys, from हन to kill.

m. (-गः)
The piles or hoemorrhoids.
E.
अर्शस, and रोग disease.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Afflicted with hoemorrhoids.
E.
अर्शोरोग, and युत affected by.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Having hoemorrhoids.
E.
अर्शोरोग and इनि aff.

m. (-तः)
The marking-nut plant, (Semecarpus anacardium.)
E.
अर्शस्, and हित proper.

m. (-भिः)
A name of BHARATA, emperor of India.
E.
ऋषभ excellent, and इञ् aff.

m. (-भ्यः)
A steer fit to be let loose.
E.
ऋषभ an ox, ञ्य aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi.
2 Venerable, respectable.
E.
ऋषि a sage, ढक् affix; also आर्ष and आर्ष्य.

f. (-ढा)
A wife married according to the Ārṣa form.
E.
आर्ष and ऊढ married.
